name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage development company focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos silver-gold project in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. The Diablillos project hosts the Oculto epithermal silver-gold deposit and has received final environmental approvals from both Salta and Catamarca provincial authorities, clearing the way for a construction decision. A completed Definitive Feasibility Study positions Diablillos as one of the premier undeveloped silver-gold projects globally, with a CAD $4.2B after-tax NPV5% and 42% IRR.
